subject: [AMBER] To build a single covalent bond between a protein and a ligand.

messages.author: PRIYANKA PUROHIT
messages.body:
Dear sir,
I am Priyanka Purohit, a Research Scholar, Berhampur University, Odisha,
India. I want to build a single covalent bond between a protein and a
ligand using AMBER18. I want to know the exact tleap command to build the
single bond. So, need ur kind suggestions.
Thanking in advance,Waiting for ur kind reply.
Regards,
Priyanka Purohit,
Research Scholar,
Berhampur university,
Odisha, India.

messages.author: Song, Lin
messages.body:
Hi,
FYI, here’s an example of building covalent bond, though it’s between metal ion and ligand. You can adapt from there: http://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial20/files/mcpbpy/1OKL_tleap.in
Best,
Lin
